headline: Bitcoin Holds Above $77,000 as Binance Hack Recovery Takes Shape
summary: Bitcoin held above the $77,000 mark as recovery efforts progressed following an exploit targeting cryptocurrency exchange Binance.
why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization. Sentiment across digital asset markets is heavily influenced by security incidents and operational recovery at major trading platforms like Binance.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Bitcoin stayed above $77,000 as market reassurance took hold following the Binance exploit recovery.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Bitcoin remained resilient above $77,000 as progress in managing the aftermath of the Binance security incident reduced market uncertainty.
